name: BEN_BATCH_RANGES
description: BEN_BATCH_RANGES contains ranges of people that are going to be processedby multi-threaded programs. The number of people in a range is set by the chunk size for that particular concurrent program. The threads within a concurrent program attempt to process ranges of people until all ranges have been exhausted. The total number of ranges will be the number of people to be processed divided by the chunk size.
